X-Files Reboot May See Return of Original Stars Scully and Mulder

Creator Chris Carter has hinted that Gillian Anderson and David Duchovny may return as FBI agents Dana Scully and Fox Mulder in a planned reboot of The X-Files. Ryan Coogler is reportedly attached to the project. The original series aired from 1993 to 2002, with subsequent revivals.
